description: This file defines the OrleansDefaultHasher class, which implements the IHasher interface to provide a default hash function using Orleans' StableHash for grain placement.

classes.name: OrleansDefaultHasher
classes.description: A default implementation of IHasher that uses Orleans' StableHash to compute hash values for grains placement.

methods.name: Description
methods.description: Returns a string describing the hash function, indicating it uses Orleans' StableHash.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Computes and returns the hash of the given byte array using StableHash.
